title: Pizza Workshop Clone
subtitle: Stretch, top, bake, and enjoy your own artisan pizza with the Pizza 4P's team.
address: Pizza 4P's Bao Khanh, Hoan Kiem, Ha Noi
about: Step into a Pizza 4P's kitchen and learn how dough, sauce, cheese, toppings, and heat come together in a balanced pizza.
Stretch your own dough, choose toppings, build one full pizza, and enjoy it fresh from the oven with the group.
No previous cooking experience is required.
note: Learn the craft behind a balanced artisan pizza.

highlights.title: Chef-led session
highlights.description: Learn directly from the Pizza 4P's workshop team.

highlights.title: Hands-on pizza making
highlights.description: Stretch, top, bake, and taste your own full pizza.

highlights.title: Beginner friendly
highlights.description: Every step is demonstrated and supported.

highlights.title: Recipe card included
highlights.description: Leave with practical tips for recreating the process at home.

plan.title: Welcome and ingredient introduction
plan.description: Meet the Pizza 4P's workshop team, get comfortable in the kitchen, and learn how the dough, sauces, cheeses, and seasonal toppings will be used throughout the session.

plan.title: Dough-stretching demonstration
plan.description: Watch a chef demonstrate how to open and stretch fermented dough by hand, keep the crust airy, and prepare the base for sauce and toppings without overworking it.

plan.title: Build your own pizza
plan.description: Stretch your dough, spread sauce, choose cheeses, and balance toppings with one-on-one guidance from the chefs so your pizza bakes evenly and tastes balanced.

plan.title: Bake, taste, and wrap up
plan.description: See how the high-heat oven finishes your pizza, enjoy the tasting together, and leave with a recipe card plus practical tips for recreating the process at home.

faqs.question: Do I need cooking experience?
faqs.answer: No previous cooking experience is required. The workshop team demonstrates each step before you try it.

faqs.question: Will I make my own pizza?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every participant stretches, tops, bakes, and tastes one full pizza during the session.

faqs.question: Are ingredients included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Dough, sauces, cheeses, toppings, kitchen tools, an apron, and a recipe card are included.

faqs.question: Can children attend?
faqs.answer: Participants aged 10-15 can attend with an adult.

hostBio: The team guides each participant through dough stretching, topping balance, baking, and tasting.

beforeYouAttend.title: Minimum age
items: Participants must be at least 10 years old.

beforeYouAttend.title: Arrival
items: Exact arrival instructions are provided after booking.
Arrive 10 minutes before the session starts.

cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the start.
If the host cancels, choose another available session or receive a full refund.

reviews.name: An Nguyen
reviews.body: The chefs explained every step clearly, and stretching the dough was much easier than expected. Highly recommend for anyone curious about pizza-making.

reviews.name: Minh Tran
reviews.body: The team gave everyone individual help without making the session feel rushed. Great balance of instruction and hands-on practice.

reviews.name: Huong Pham
reviews.body: My pizza came out better than I expected. The workshop felt polished, well-paced, and genuinely hands-on from start to finish.

plan.title: Understanding thoughtful partnership

plan.title: Communication and active listening

plan.title: Care plans and healthy boundaries

faqs.question: Is this workshop only for people in relationships?
faqs.answer: No. Singles and couples are welcome. The skills apply to dating, committed relationships, and future partnerships.

faqs.question: Will I have to share private relationship details?
faqs.answer: No. You can participate using fictional examples and share only what feels comfortable.

faqs.question: Can couples attend together?
faqs.answer: Yes. Couples may attend together, and individual participants are equally welcome.
